🎬 40 YEARS OF STAR TREK IV 🎬
Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home released on November 26, 1986 — 40 years ago — and the crew went back in time to save the whales.
To mark the anniversary, we're spotlighting a fan edit from the collection: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home - Full Circle - Fan Edit.
The voyage home, in the Full Circle cut.
DM us for the link — THE WORLD'S LARGEST FAN EDIT COLLECTION.
